goal: Lets users importing descriptors opt out of a rescan when they know the addresses have no prior history
Avoids costly, unnecessary rescans for bulk watch-only imports, per the author's 2M-address example
reviewability: Needs rebase and conflicts with three other open wallet PRs
Also has unresolved test-correctness concerns from a reviewer with no confirmed fix since
agreement: Early concept ACK but followed by a blocking Changes Requested review (rkrux)
Unaddressed objection: test may not validate the never/now distinction, no confirming re-review (rkrux)
Recurring objection: magic -1 sentinel values kept reappearing across pushes (furszy, achow101)
Author pushed fixes but no maintainer has since signed off

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes a real but narrow performance pain point in bulk descriptor imports
Benefit is limited to users doing large watch-only imports, not a broad audience
Carries a mild footgun of silently skipping rescan on funded addresses, but no fund-loss or consensus risk
